Chapter 6154: Enigma Destroyed Again

Chapter 6154: Enigma Destroyed Again

“Crack!” Li Qiye broke the bottle and released the blue liquid. The flow was nothing short of catastrophic. A single drop could flatten the galaxy above.

As these liquid particles drifted into the air, they initiated a reaction like no other. Anything with the smallest traces of metal within them upon contact with the liquid would instantly assemble into a mecha.

“Clank! Clank! Clank!” Thus, numerous mechas manifested into reality.

Li Qiye immediately placed his palms together, changing various affinities into the primordial and forcing the Energy Nexus back.

The bright particles couldn’t do anything and were forced back into a liquid form again. He forcefully poured it into the basin with the tree. His primordial affinity forced the two to fuse, turning the liquid into a part of the soil.

The dried tree was no different than a desert receiving a magical rain. It became resplendent and its leaves turned green. They brimmed with life and didn’t stop becoming stronger.

“We leave the rest to time.” Li Qiye said, finishing the forging and nourishing processes.

“If only I can repay your kindness, Sir.” The nebula was filled with gratitude.

“I have resolved this fate thread.” Li Qiye said, returning the basin to the nebula.

It wrapped around the basin and the tree, continuing to gestate it.

“You don’t have to keep doing this.” He said.

“I shall contribute the last of my strength for they have granted me life and purpose.” She said.

“Can’t ask for a better disciple.” Li Qiye nodded approvingly and was happy for the three immortals.

“Thank you, Sir, it’s a shame I cannot see you again in the future.” She bid farewell.

“I’ve made it up with just this one time.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Yes, I do not worry about Three Immortals World anymore.” The nebula took the form of a woman bowing and said: “I leave it to you, Sir.”

With that, the nebula wrapped around the tree again, assuming a state of alert. The dao crystals were ready to fire at the next visitor.

Li Qiye sighed after seeing this.

***

The earth shattered and the laws were destroyed. Enigma Dynasty was torn asunder, becoming a land of death.

Dust storms covered the air and wouldn’t dissipate. This didn’t matter since only ruins were left behind.

“Enigma was destroyed!” The news of its demise spread across Sin and stunned everyone.

“No one can stop Immortal Suppression.” A big shot trembled in horror.

“One of the three great dynasties with numerous emperors…” A desolate god said.

“Will it be rebuilt again?” An emperor wondered.

This was far from its first demise but it kept on popping up again.

“Their ancestors and emperors are captured.” A cultivator with a strong information network received the news.

“They didn’t die in battle?” This surprised listeners. After all, capturing mighty cultivators was far harder than killing them.

“Immortal Suppressor personally captured them?” An ancestor speculated because not even Transcendent Emperor could do something like this.

“No, Transcendent Emperor used Dingtian Cauldron to suppress them.” An emperor who saw the battle in person said.

“Dingtian Cauldron, the legendary immortal treasure.” Listeners took a deep breath.
